local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local player=Players.LocalPlayer
local gui=player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):FindFirstChild("EnergyUI")
if gui then gui:Destroy() end
gui=Instance.new("ScreenGui");gui.Name="EnergyUI";gui.ResetOnSpawn=false;gui.Parent=player.PlayerGui

local panel=Instance.new("Frame")
panel.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0,.5)
panel.Position=UDim2.new(0,18,.5,0)
panel.Size=UDim2.new(0,225,0,205)
panel.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(22,27,37)
panel.BackgroundTransparency=.08
panel.BorderSizePixel=0
panel.Parent=gui
local corner=Instance.new("UICorner");corner.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,16);corner.Parent=panel
local stroke=Instance.new("UIStroke");stroke.Thickness=2;stroke.Color=Color3.fromRGB(80,190,255);stroke.Transparency=.25;stroke.Parent=panel

local title=Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Position=UDim2.new(0,14,0,8);title.Size=UDim2.new(1,-28,0,32);title.BackgroundTransparency=1
title.Text="⚡ ENERGY";title.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left;title.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBlack;title.TextSize=22;title.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,220,80);title.Parent=panel

local amount=Instance.new("TextLabel")
amount.Position=UDim2.new(0,14,0,38);amount.Size=UDim2.new(1,-28,0,38);amount.BackgroundTransparency=1
amount.Text="0";amount.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left;amount.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBlack;amount.TextSize=32;amount.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1);amount.Parent=panel

local function row(y,labelText)
 local l=Instance.new("TextLabel");l.Position=UDim2.new(0,14,0,y);l.Size=UDim2.new(1,-28,0,30);l.BackgroundTransparency=1
 l.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left;l.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;l.TextSize=16;l.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(195,205,220);l.Parent=panel
 l.Text=labelText;return l
end
local speedRow=row(88,"Speed: 16")
local worthRow=row(122,"Energy per Orb: 1")
local maxRow=row(156,"Maximum Orbs: 10")

local stats=player:WaitForChild("leaderstats")
local energy=stats:WaitForChild("Energy")
local speed=player:WaitForChild("SpeedLevel")
local worth=player:WaitForChild("WorthLevel")
local orbAmount=player:WaitForChild("AmountLevel")

local function update()
 amount.Text=tostring(energy.Value)
 speedRow.Text="Speed: "..tostring(16+(speed.Value*2))
 worthRow.Text="Energy per Orb: "..tostring(1+worth.Value)
 maxRow.Text="Maximum Orbs: "..tostring(10+(orbAmount.Value*2))
end
energy:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(update)
speed:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(update)
worth:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(update)
orbAmount:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(update)
update()
